design_concept: Cinematic-Spiritual (Warm Gold, Brown, Cream, Maroon). Grounded, premium, emotionally resonant matching the Ashin Jinarakkhita documentary poster.

typography.guidelines: Use 'Playfair Display' (font-serif) for all major headings (H1, H2, H3). Apply tracking-tight for elegance. Use 'DM Sans' (font-sans) for body text, form inputs, seat maps, and admin data tables for extreme legibility. Use 'Dancing Script' for the maroon cursive accent text 'Membangunkannya'.

hero_section_strategy.desktop: Split layout (Grid 12 cols). Left (col-span-6): Cinematic serif typography (dark brown), KBI logo, KBI multi-logo top-left logic, KBI info bar (cream with brown circular icons), maroon 'PEMESANAN TIKET' label/CTA. Right (col-span-6): The official poster image rendered inside a beautiful rounded-2xl frame. Add a soft, warm ambient shadow (shadow-2xl shadow-yellow-900/20). DO NOT crop or stretch the poster; maintain its natural portrait aspect ratio.
hero_section_strategy.mobile: Stacked layout. Place the poster prominent at the top (full width, rounded-b-3xl, respecting aspect ratio). Below it, display the event details and CTAs in a cleanly padded section. Alternative: Full height container with the poster as a background and a heavy gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#F8F5EE] via-[#F8F5EE]/90 to-transparent) on the lower 50% to ensure dark serif text is fully readable.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary uses Gold (#C49A45) with dark brown text (#1A1105). Secondary/Accent uses Maroon (#7A241F) with white text. Hover states: scale-105 with slightly increased brightness/shadow. Do not use default Vercel-black.
component_guidelines.cards_public: Soft rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl corners. Surface color #FDFBF7. Thin, subtle borders (border border-[#D9D0C1]/40). Shadow: shadow-lg shadow-amber-900/5. Generous padding (p-6 to p-8).
component_guidelines.cards_admin: Dense, functional flat cards. rounded-lg or rounded-xl, crisp borders (border-[#D9D0C1]). Minimal to no drop-shadow.
component_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn components. Inputs must have warm off-white background (bg-white/60) and brown/gold focus rings (focus:ring-primary). Remove any default blue outlines.
component_guidelines.seat_map: High legibility required. Available seats: muted cream/border color. Selected seats: Maroon or Gold. Booked/Unavailable seats: greyish brown (#E5DED5) and disabled. The 'LAYAR' (screen) indicator must be visually prominent, perhaps with a subtle cinematic glow.
component_guidelines.navigation: Sticky headers should use crystal glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F8F5EE]/80) with a subtle bottom border. Do not use fully transparent headers if content scrolls behind them.

layouts.spacing: Generous. p-6, p-8, p-12 for public-facing elements. Give the aesthetic room to breathe.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar or top-nav based layout. Keep data dense and scannable but swap standard greys for muted warm tones (e.g., hover:bg-[#E5DED5]/30 for table rows).

motion.guidelines: Smooth micro-interactions. Hovering over movie sessions/cards should apply a slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow expansion. CTAs must have hover feedback. Avoid harsh, instant transitions (use transition-all duration-300 ease-out).

poster.description: The official Ashin Jinarakkhita event poster. Needs to dictate the visual theme of the site.

accessibility.contrast: Deep brown text (#2C1E16) on cream backgrounds (#F8F5EE) exceeds WCAG standards. Gold buttons must use very dark brown text (#1A1105) for sufficient contrast.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements, inputs, form submissions, seats, and tables MUST retain their `data-testid` attributes. Do not remove or alter existing test identifiers.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST completely replace the old Navy (#1E3A5F) / Orange (#D56115) theme with the new Gold/Brown/Cream/Maroon palette defined here.
Map these colors to Tailwind CSS via CSS variables (in index.css) to ensure shadcn/ui components adopt them natively.
Keep all Indonesian text verbatim. Do not change content, pricing, or logic.
Ensure the booking flow (Data Diri, Pilih Sesi, SeatMap, Payment), Admin panels, Walk-in monitor, and Mobile Check-in remain fully functional and retain their data-testids.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic: No generic centered landing page layouts, no simplistic linear gradients. Build asymmetrical layouts for the hero, utilize depth, z-index layering, and glassmorphism.
Only generate guidelines for .js/.jsx files as requested by the user, not .tsx.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays where text intersects with background content. Always use solid or blurred backdrops.
instructions_to_main_agent: Step 1: Replace global CSS variables in index.css with the provided HSL values to set the new theme.
Step 2: Add Google Fonts imports for Playfair Display, DM Sans, and Dancing Script in index.css. Update tailwind.config.js font families.
Step 3: Redesign the Hero section on the landing page (Home.js/jsx) applying the split/stack strategy, incorporating the provided poster URL.
Step 4: Update the typography across all pages: font-serif for major headings, font-sans for body/admin, and cursive for special accents.
Step 5: Apply updated styling (rounded corners, warm shadows, pill-shaped buttons) to the Booking Flow, QRIS Payment step, SeatMap, and UI cards.
Step 6: Update the Admin Dashboard and Walk-in monitor pages to inherit the warm palette while preserving their dense, highly legible layout and functionality.
